title: Busan's celebrity shark Bukang-i turns out to be endangered species
summary: Bukang-i, the shark that has spent nearly three weeks in a canal at Busan’s North Port Waterfront Park, has been identified as a female dusky shark about 3 meters long, researchers said…

blocks.text: Bukang-i, the shark that has spent nearly three weeks in a canal at Busan’s North Port Waterfront Park, has been identified as a female dusky shark about 3 meters long, researchers said Tuesday. The National Institute of Fisheries Science confirmed the species after analyzing close-up footage that showed a pronounced ridge between its first and second dorsal fins. Researchers initially considered it likely to be either a copper shark or a dusky shark after the animal was spotted Sept. 18. The closely related species are difficult to distinguish by sight, but copper sharks lack the ridge. READ: Lost shark becomes viral […]...
